headline: Monitoring & Admin covers a monitoring dashboard with security, activity and agent views plus a set of admin tabs (agents, tools, icons, sandbox, skills); all ten tickets are marked ready for release, and the code review backed up five of them while the other five could not be settled from the code that was examined.
what_is_there: The product clearly has a Monitoring section built as its own navigation area with sub-pages, and the configuration behind it names specific views for security events, agent status, action logs and MCP call history, including which of them a sub-admin is allowed to see. There is also supporting evidence for admin tabs covering agents, tools and custom icon management.
what_is_unclear: The analysis never saw the code for the Monitoring screens themselves, so the overview page of system health metrics, the MCP call history view, filtering on action logs, sandbox capacity management and the skill create/edit/delete tab could not be confirmed either way — the sandbox capacity settings that were found appear to sit under Settings rather than Monitoring. Even for the confirmed items, only the surrounding wiring and configuration were seen, not the screens themselves, so behaviour such as real-time alerting remains unchecked.
suggested_action: Ask someone with access to the running build to walk through each Monitoring sub-tab and confirm the five unconfirmed ones — overview metrics, MCP call history, action log filtering, sandbox capacity management and the skill manager — actually appear and work as described.
caveat: One of the reference documents used during the review describes a different product area and was disregarded; it should not be treated as evidence about this feature area.
